with pro as (
select 
users.id as provider_user_id,
users.mobile as provider_mobile ,
concat(providers.name , ' ' ,providers.surname ) as provider_name,
provider_clusters.cluster_id,
providers.balance,
(case when regions.region_type = 3 then regions.id else regions.parent_id end) as provider_region_id 

from users 
inner join providers on providers.id = users.userable_id 
and providers.provider_status = 1 
and providers.device_status = 1 
left join provider_clusters on provider_clusters.provider_user_id = users.id 
inner join regions on regions.id = providers.region_id 

where 
users.userable_type like '%%Provider%%'
and users.state= 1

),

pre_pps as (
select 
pps.provider_user_id,
count(pps.id) as pre_pps_count

from 
provider_price_suggestions  as pps 

where 
date(pps.created_at) >= '2025-12-27'
and date(pps.created_at) <= '2026-02-27'

group by 
pps.provider_user_id), 

post_pps as (
select 
pps.provider_user_id,
count(pps.id) as post_pps_count

from 
provider_price_suggestions as pps

where 
date(pps.created_at) >= '2026-02-28'

group by 
pps.provider_user_id), 

exist_active_book as (
select 
aapbc.provider_user_id,
--a.region_id as booking_region_id,
count(bookings.id) as exist_booking_count

from bookings 
inner join algo_a_provider_bookings_container aapbc on aapbc.booking_id = bookings.id 
--inner join algo_a_distribution_report as a on a.booking_id = aapbc.booking_id 
where 
bookings.book_status != 5 
and bookings.provider_user_id is null 
and date(bookings.booking_date) >= current_date

group by 
aapbc.provider_user_id
--,a.region_id
),

exist_booking_details as (
select 
aapbc.provider_user_id,
bookings.id as booking_id,
subservices.title as subservice_title,
bookings.created_at as booking_created_at,
concat(members.name, ' ', members.surname) as member_name,
users.mobile

from bookings 
inner join subservices on subservices.id = bookings.subservice_id
inner join algo_a_provider_bookings_container aapbc on aapbc.booking_id = bookings.id 
inner join users on users.id = bookings.member_user_id 
and users.userable_type like '%%Member%%'
inner join members on members.id = users.userable_id 

where 
bookings.book_status != 5 
and bookings.provider_user_id is null
and date(bookings.booking_date) >= current_date
),

regions_title as (
select 
regions.id as region_id ,
regions.title as region_title,
regions.parent_id as region_parent_id
from regions 
where 
regions.region_type =3 )

select 
*
from pro 
inner join exist_active_book on pro.provider_user_id = exist_active_book.provider_user_id 
left join pre_pps on pre_pps.provider_user_id = pro.provider_user_id 
left join post_pps on post_pps.provider_user_id = pro.provider_user_id 
left join regions_title on regions_title.region_id = pro.provider_region_id
--inner join exist_booking_details on exist_booking_details.provider_user_id = pro.provider_user_id
